summary: A mixed day dominated by legal rulings affecting counsel's practice and retail operations. Three Supreme/High Court judgments reshape lawyer access, passport procedures, and Bar Council appointments, while MDR regulations threaten retail price increases this festive season.

bullets.text: Delhi HC: Most lawyers cannot afford paid legal databases; Indian Kanoon's free access serves right-to-information purpose in right-to-be-forgotten case.
Supreme Court: Women lawyers need not be designated Senior Advocates for co-option to State Bar Councils, expanding eligibility pool.
Kerala HC: Divorce decree not required to delete ex-spouse's name from passport; application sufficient.
MDR regulation effect: Retailers and apparel makers warn of price hikes or lower festive discounts amid inflation and logistics costs.
Reliance raising $1.3 billion in rupee bond sale, first issuance since 2023.
